editionLabel: Queen Games English rules, revised edition 2019
firstPlayerRule: After everyone is dealt starting money (cards dealt one at a time until each player has 20 or more), the player with the fewest money cards starts.
officialTieBreak: If players have the same number of cards, the one with the lowest total money starts; if still tied, the younger player starts.
clarifications: Play proceeds clockwise, beginning with the starting player.
In the two-player game the imaginary third player, Dirk, never takes turns.
